description: Unloaded voltage divider. r1 is the top resistor, from the supply to the output. r2 is the bottom resistor, from the output to ground. Returns the output voltage, the string current, and the power in each resistor as exact rationals. Both resistors must be positive. A zero supply gives zero output, zero current and zero power. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/voltage-divider
